package.name: cpm_common_interfaces
package.description: Message types shared by 2+ apps in the JobMgr/WeighApp ROS2/DDS migration -- either because two apps talk directly over the same DDS topic (the 4 JobMgr<->WeighApp direct channels, Development-Plan.txt Step 6.1), or because a real SCS enum/struct is used directly by more than one app's own code, not just via a channel binding (confirmed by grep before anything was moved here -- see each .msg's header comment for the specific evidence). Both job_mgr_interfaces and weigh_app_interfaces depend on this package; it depends on neither, to keep the dependency direction one-way.
